name: zeffect_handle_fog_event
description: zEffect::HandleFogEvent dispatches flagged fog state, color, altitude, and distance updates to the active effect world.
known_limits: No isolated VC COFF byte comparison is recorded for this event handler; tier S verification is deferred to a coherent zEffect event-handler/source-cluster pass.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja evidence for 0x459510 validates flag-gated calls to SetPendingFogState, SetPendingFogColorRgb01, SetPendingFogAltitudeRange, and SetPendingFogRange through g_zEffect_World, then return value 2.
The native smoke verifies all four fog flag paths update the world pending fields and pending flag mask, and verifies a zero-flag event leaves the world unchanged while still returning 2.
